tools.name: eyworks_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies your eyworks API client can access, with their guids. Start here to find the company and nursery ids. eyworks Public API: GET /companies.

tools.name: eyworks_get_company
tools.description: Get one company: name, address, legal registration and contact details. eyworks Public API: GET /companies/{companyId}.

tools.name: eyworks_list_company_nurseries
tools.description: List the nurseries of one company that your client can access, with their guids, names and tags. eyworks Public API: GET /companies/{companyId}/nurseries.

tools.name: eyworks_get_nursery
tools.description: Get one nursery: address, contact, capacity, opening hours and tags. eyworks Public API: GET /nurseries/{nurseryId}.

tools.name: eyworks_list_rooms
tools.description: List the rooms of one nursery with their capacity and age ranges. eyworks Public API: GET /nurseries/{nurseryId}/rooms.

tools.name: eyworks_list_employees
tools.description: List the employees of one nursery, with status, start and leave dates. Personal data: use only for the nursery's own purposes. eyworks Public API: GET /nurseries/{nurseryId}/employees.

tools.name: eyworks_list_children
tools.description: List the child records of one nursery, with status, start and leave dates and date of birth. Personal data about children: use only for the nursery's own purposes. eyworks Public API: GET /nurseries/{nurseryId}/children.

tools.name: eyworks_get_availability
tools.description: Get the availability of one nursery, as a nursery-level breakdown. Needs the availability:read scope. eyworks Public API: GET /nurseries/{nurseryId}/availability.
